constraints.definition:
CHECK (((capabilities <@ ARRAY['security.company_policy'::text, 'security.ip_access'::text, 'security.mfa_management'::text]) AND (array_position(capabilities, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (cardinality(capabilities) = ((
CASE
    WHEN ('security.company_policy'::text = ANY (capabilities)) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END +
CASE
    WHEN ('security.ip_access'::text = ANY (capabilities)) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN ('security.mfa_management'::text = ANY (capabilities)) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END))))

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER billing_plan_version_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."BillingPlanVersion" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION billing_plan_version_immutable()
